player_prompt.intro:
O Player {player_id} mo Connect Four.
Simbolo ya disk ya gago: {symbol}.
Bora ya dibeke di na {num_rows} dinama le {num_cols} dikolone.
Bana ba dibeke ba tsamaya ba tlhokile disk ya bone mo koloneng (0 go {end_col}).
Yo o nang mo ya nna o a tsamaia (disk ya gagwe) nne kwa godimo, kwa kafa, kwa diagonal o a tsamaia.
Ka nako ya gago, ngwana kolone ya nomoro mo dikotsi tse di squared go dira tshwetso ya gago.
Ejale: '[col 4]' kana '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Boto ya motshameko ga e bonale mo batshameking.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Tsamaiso ya gagwe e sa tsamayeng ka tsela. Tsamaiso e e eleng ya nna: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Tshwetso ya gagwe e sa tsamayeng. Kolone {col} e kwa ntle ga mafelo.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is full.

action.dropped_disk: Player {player_id} o tlhokile disk ya gagwe ({player_symbol}) mo kolonong {col}.

outcome.win: Motshameki {player_id} o a fenya ka go kopanya tse nnè!
outcome.draw: Motshameko o ne wa felela ka go se tseye sepe.
